<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def framed(fr):
    b=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    gs=set((r,c) for r in range(18,45) for c in range(15,50) if b[r][c]=='g')
    if not gs: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in gs]; cs=[c for r,c in gs]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
print('home framed:', framed(current_frame))
for a in ['UP','UP','DOWN','DOWN']:
    action([a])
    print(a,'->', framed(current_frame))
# reset to home
action(['RIGHT'])
print('after RIGHT:', framed(current_frame))
action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT (home?):', framed(current_frame))
</parameter>
